newsitem.title: USA: PepsiCo to create bottling unit - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: PepsiCo to create bottling unit - WSJ.

text.p: PepsiCo Inc plans to reorganize its North American bottling operations by creating a separate unit, the Wall Street Journal said.
In Monday's electronic edition, the Journal said the reorganization plan was expected to be announced to employees later today.
The newspaper said it may signal a prelude to an eventual spinoff and public offering of part of the $6 billion-a-year bottling business -- a move that was denied by PepsiCo officials.
Company officials said the reorganization is an effort to give the bottling operations more autonomy and accountability.
The new entity is to be called PepsiCola Bottling Co. It is expected to have its own management structure, led by a president.
Company officials declined to identify the new president, but said the person would report to Brenda Barnes, president and chief executive of Pepsi-Cola's North American business.
